summary: Grace-window deprovisioning and credential rotation for departing data scientist
description:
Issue summary:
Maria Lopez (maria.lopez@redwood.com), Senior Data Scientist, notified HR of resignation effective 2026-02-25. HR requests a staggered deprovisioning: a 48-hour grace window for handover communications (Slack, GitHub) but immediate rotation and secure escrow for all credentials, and ownership transfer for any long-lived service accounts or keys she administers.

Impact:
- Potential sensitive access: Maria is listed as an owner on two service accounts used by training pipelines and is a member of the KMS key policy for 'ds-prod-key'. If ownership and secrets are not rotated before departure, there is risk of credential leakage or continued access.
- Risk to CI/CD and scheduled training jobs if service-account ownership is changed without a handoff.

Background/Context:
- Employee is permitted a short handover period per HR request; security policy requires rotation for privileged credentials on exit, but current playbooks have ambiguity around short grace windows for non-engineer-facing chat/GitHub access.
- Maria used a company MacBook (asset tag HW-DS-1123) enrolled via corporate MDM and also used her personal laptop intermittently (BYOD) with corporate email via O365. HR asks for guidance on wiping corporate device and recommended steps for BYOD where corporate data existed.

Request:
1) Produce authoritative list of all Google Cloud and AWS service accounts and IAM roles where maria.lopez@redwood.com is owner or admin.
2) Rotate all secrets that Maria had access to (service account keys, any stored credentials in Vault, KMS key rewrap or key rotation where necessary).
3) Transfer ownership of user-managed service accounts and update downstream CI pipelines to new service principals; coordinate with Data Platform to schedule safe cutover windows.
4) Wipe and return corporate laptop; provide recommended steps for securing/removing corporate data from BYOD.
5) Clarify policy: confirm allowed grace window for Slack/GitHub read/write for departing full-time vs contractor and record any exception approvals.

Desired timeline: initial inventory and rotation plan by 2026-02-22, rotation and ownership changes completed before 2026-02-25 departure.
investigation_notes: 2026-02-20 10:15 - Ran GCP audit query: gcloud iam service-accounts list --filter='email:maria.lopez@redwood.com' and cross-referenced IAM bindings for projects/prod and projects/ds-training.
Findings: Maria is owner of service-account ds-train-sa@redwood-prod. Project-level IAM shows her in roles/owner for project ds-experiments (added 2024-11-02).
Checked KMS policy on ds-prod-key: maria.lopez@redwood.com has cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and cryptoKeyVersioner roles via group 'ds-leads'.
Checked Vault: Maria has two explicit tokens with access to /secret/ds-experiments; long-lived approle credentials exist for a helper script (app-legacy-runner).

Device check: MDM shows HW-DS-1123 enrolled; last MDM sync 2026-02-18. No corporate mobile device registered. Personal laptop not enrolled; HR reports only corporate email was used via browser and Outlook app.
Risk assessment: If service-account keys are rotated without a coordinated handoff, scheduled jobs may fail. If KMS key is rotated/rewrapped, dependent artifacts need re-encryption plan.
comments: Maya Chen (HR) 2026-02-20: Employee requests 48h handover window for Slack and GitHub to finish docs. Security wants immediate lock for admin access. Asked IT to propose a compromise.

Arjun Patel (IT/Ops) 2026-02-20: Acknowledged. I'll inventory service accounts and list proposed owners by EOD 2026-02-21. Propose to rotate service-account keys and Vault credentials immediately, but allow Slack/GitHub write access for 48h limited to specific channels/repos and tracked via audit. Will coordinate with Data Platform for pipeline cutovers.

Samira Gonzalez (SRE) 2026-02-21: Noted ds-train-sa is referenced in two cron jobs (train-nightly, data-export). Need 72h notice for safe rebinds or we risk missed runs. Recommend canary cutover: switch one non-critical run first.
Maya Chen (HR) 2026-02-21: HR approves 48h Slack/GitHub window but requires all privileged credentials rotated before last working day. Please document exception approval here.

Arjun Patel (IT/Ops) 2026-02-22: Inventory attached (internal link): service accounts found: ds-train-sa@redwood-prod, ds-legacy-runner@redwood-prod. Proposed new owners: data-platform-bot@redwood-prod. Scheduled rotation 2026-02-23 02:00 UTC. Planning MDM wipe on 2026-02-25 morning.
resolution_notes: 1) Create authoritative inventory of Maria's ownership and access (Arjun) - completed 2026-02-21.
2) Rotate Vault approle and revoke existing tokens for helper scripts; re-issue new approles bound to new service principals (Arjun/SRE) - scheduled 2026-02-23 02:00 UTC.
3) Reassign service-account owners to data-platform-bot@redwood-prod, update IAM policies; run canary job for train-nightly with new principal (Samira) - canary 2026-02-23 05:00 UTC.

4) KMS: perform key rewrap for ds-prod-key and update dependent services to use new key version; if re-encrypt needed, coordinate with Data Platform for offline rewrap (Crypto team) - planned 2026-02-24.
5) Device: schedule return of HW-DS-1123 and perform MDM wipe upon receipt; provide BYOD guidance to Maria and request she remove corporate Outlook profile and change local passwords (Arjun/IT).
6) Post-exit: enable elevated logging and host-level alerting for two weeks on projects ds-experiments and ds-training (Monitoring team).

Policy clarification: HR and Security to record exception: 48h Slack/GitHub handover allowed for full-time departing staff when approved by HR + Security; exception ticket filed here as audit evidence (Maya).
Follow-up items: update Offboarding Runbook to explicitly enumerate steps for KMS-owned accounts and BYOD guidance (owner: Security).
